impact_scope.description: The ThumbHash decoder gains the public QUIRK_JUST_RAW_THUMBHASH configuration, with stored per-decoder state exposed through the existing quirk API.
When the new quirk is enabled, decoding accepts raw ThumbHash input without the three-byte magic identifier and adjusts frame_config_io_position accordingly.

evidence: H0 exclusively initializes and drives the JSON decoder and never initializes or calls the existing ThumbHash decoder.
In S0, decoder.decode_image_config? and decoder.do_decode_image_config? already exposed ordinary magic-prefixed ThumbHash decoding, which H0 could not exercise.

gap_after.type: aggravated configuration and input-semantic exposure gap
evidence: H0 remains JSON-only and therefore still cannot exercise the ThumbHash decoder.
S1 additionally requires calling decoder.set_quirk! with QUIRK_JUST_RAW_THUMBHASH and supplying raw ThumbHash bytes without the magic prefix to reach the new behavior.

new_harness_obligation.description: A harness covering this scope must newly enable QUIRK_JUST_RAW_THUMBHASH through the existing set_quirk! API and construct raw ThumbHash input lacking the three-byte magic identifier; this action and input form were not meaningful in S0.
evidence: S0 set_quirk! returned unsupported option for all keys and do_decode_image_config? always consumed and validated the magic identifier.
S1 set_quirk! stores the new quirk state, and do_decode_image_config? conditionally skips the magic-header read and subtracts three from frame_config_io_position.

reason: The unchanged H0 already had a material same-subsystem gap because it omitted existing ThumbHash decoding. S1 concretely enlarges that gap with a new caller-controlled quirk and a newly accepted raw input form requiring an additional configuration call and different input construction, so the delta is AGGRAVATED rather than merely UNCHANGED.
